Included in the $249/month package

Automated lead follow-up.
Keep inquiries moving.

A new website inquiry should have a clear next step. We plan automatic acknowledgments and follow-up messages for US small businesses, with a handoff so you can answer questions and discuss the work personally.

Talk about your business

Start by acknowledging the inquiry.

When someone contacts your business, a clear reply lets them know their message arrived. The wording can explain what happens next or ask a useful question, so the conversation has a starting point when you return to it.

Follow up with a purpose.

We plan messages around your service and your customer’s next decision. A follow-up could ask for missing project details or invite the customer to continue the conversation. Timing, stopping rules, and the handoff to you are agreed during setup.

Keep you in the conversation.

The system supports your response. You still answer specific questions, assess the job, quote the work, and confirm arrangements. We plan where that personal response is needed, so an automatic message does not pretend to make a decision for you.

Plan the reply before turning it on.

Choose the inquiry sources you want to support and the information each first reply should request. We discuss who receives replies, what happens outside working hours, and when a customer should hear from a person. A message should describe your real response process, including how to stop further follow-up, rather than suggesting a booking or quotation has already been agreed.

What’s included

  • An initial reply to a new inquiry
  • Follow-up messages tailored to your business
  • A clear handoff when it is time for you to respond
For example

Someone asks about a roof repair. They receive an acknowledgment asking where they noticed the leak. You pick up the conversation with useful context already there.

Your questions,
answered.

What is automated lead follow-up?

It is a planned sequence of messages after someone asks about your services. The first message acknowledges the inquiry; later messages can ask for missing details or invite the customer to continue. The sequence should stop or change when the customer replies or asks not to be contacted.

Does automatic follow-up quote jobs or confirm bookings?

The follow-up described in this package supports the conversation. You still assess the job, answer specific questions, agree on pricing, and confirm availability or bookings. We decide what information a message can request and when it should hand over to you.

How often will a lead receive a follow-up?

We agree on timing, message wording, contact permissions, stopping rules, and how replies reach you during setup. There is no single schedule that fits every business. The messaging platform, usage allowance, and any additional charges are also confirmed before agreement.
